inputs.title: Inputs
inputs.manifestHint: JSON or YAML. Accepts an array or { projects: [] }. Ranks optional and per track. Use tracks: [] to rank a project in several tracks at once.
inputs.rulesHint: Markdown or TXT. Passed to every agent verbatim, as untrusted context.
inputs.rubricHint: YAML, JSON or the markdown criteria table. No file means the built-in neutral rubric.
inputs.chooseManifest: Choose a manifest file to validate it.

models.cacheResourcesHint: Reuse a repository or video already harvested in this session instead of downloading it again. Clear it to force a fresh download.

e1.name: Impact & problem fit
e1.focus: Who benefits, how much it matters, and whether the project fits a published problem statement.

e2.name: AI tooling
e2.focus: Which models are actually used at runtime, how deliberately they are chosen, and whether the integration goes beyond a thin wrapper.

e3.name: Technical depth
e3.focus: Architecture, code quality, error handling, tests, build story and evidence of real craft.

e4.name: Demo & video
e4.focus: Whether the demo shows the product working end to end, whether the video is credible and well paced, and whether it matches the repository.

e5.name: Evidence & rules
e5.focus: Whether claims are supported by artefacts, whether the work is new, and whether hard rules are met.

e6.name: Cross-cutting chair
e6.focus: Whole-project coherence, contradictions between sources, and gaps the specialist lenses may miss.

v1.name: Rubric & scoring verifier
v1.focus: Weights, scale, evidence per criterion, arithmetic, and consistency between criterion scores and the overall.

v2.name: Evidence & integrity verifier
v2.focus: Unsupported claims, fabricated citations, anchoring to supplied ranks, disqualifiers and missing evidence.
